company.shortDescription: Roomblocker is a San Francisco, CA-based company that offers hotel booking services.
company.description:
Roomblocker is a hotel booking service for people who wish to reserve a block of hotel rooms for a conference, wedding, or other group event.

Founded in 2014, Roomblocker is headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company has permanently shut down on July 14, 2017.
